about.title: About the Battles of Legend: Glorious Gallery set
paragraphs: Battles of Legend: Glorious Gallery is a Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG special set released on 4 June 2026, in the SEVENS & GO RUSH!! era. It has 146 cards, and with the 35 other rarities there are 181 to collect in all.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 146 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 181, adding the 35 other rarities).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
